mathematical_sources.location: Journal of Logic and Computation 34 (2024), 1159–1171, §4.4, p. 1169.
mathematical_sources.note: The authors construct a theory of an equivalence relation from two disjoint computably enumerable sets. Their criterion for essential undecidability is recursive inseparability of the two sets. Corollary 4.8 concerns internal first-order theories generated by nullary predicates in a category.
mathematical_sources.title: There are no minimal essentially undecidable theories
